name: Aster Worker Code Benchmark v2
purpose: Compare delegation/cooperation designs across several coding benchmark families, including overhead controls. Does not prescribe parent/child architecture.
model_input_allowlist: base repository workspace from materials.setup, prepared by trusted host

protocol.unit_of_analysis: one original upstream task; do not concatenate exercises or split one into extra tasks
protocol.architecture: No forced worker count, read-only worker role or centralized writer. Compare isolated patch, test generation or investigation strategies under the same task contract.
protocol.fairness: Freeze model, total team token/tool/time budgets, dependency snapshots and arm order before model runs; audit annotations never enter prompts.
protocol.success: Native independent verifier/reward + complete expected tests; local oracle preparation is not agent success.
metrics: whole-team input/output/cache tokens and priced cost
integration rework and conflicts when instrumented
protocol.failures: Report environment/service failures, unresolved cases and no-delegation; do not silently drop tasks or retry one arm.
protocol.training: evaluation only; preserve upstream canaries; no training from these tasks or trajectories
protocol.next_gate: Each environment must show empty/starter failure and reference success with the actual independent verifier before paid model comparison.
